scope: Additional 19-file known-resonance synthetic challenge; no public or private speech.

chronology.reason: The first grid has F3=2600 Hz and glides F3=2500..2900 Hz, near the fixed 2750 Hz prior. Its ablation had identical aggregate scores. Broader known resonances are an additional check.
chronology.status: Post-screen diagnostic extension using existing fixtures, not an independent preregistered holdout.

selector_config.reference_assumption: Adult-female vowel prior from the published manual; not speaker-neutral.
selector_config.bandwidth_policy: Finite nonnegative bandwidth; no maximum-bandwidth rejection.
selector_config.candidate_limit_policy: Fail explicitly; no candidate pruning or beam search.
selector_config.cost_time_basis: Per input frame; no elapsed-time scaling. Supply the complete frame grid.
selector_config.gap_policy: Missing emission each frame; boundary charge on entry and reentry; no latent frequency.
selector_config.restart_policy: No free restart; only the first frame has no incoming transition.
selector_config.tie_policy: Lexicographic raw indices, missing after real indices; final state then predecessors.
selector_config.coefficient_source: Manual illustrative unit costs, not asserted software defaults.
selector_config.limitation: A stable wrong candidate can remain preferred; continuity does not identify resonances.

ablation_config.reference_assumption: Adult-female vowel prior from the published manual; not speaker-neutral.
ablation_config.bandwidth_policy: Finite nonnegative bandwidth; no maximum-bandwidth rejection.
ablation_config.candidate_limit_policy: Fail explicitly; no candidate pruning or beam search.
ablation_config.cost_time_basis: Per input frame; no elapsed-time scaling. Supply the complete frame grid.
ablation_config.gap_policy: Missing emission each frame; boundary charge on entry and reentry; no latent frequency.
ablation_config.restart_policy: No free restart; only the first frame has no incoming transition.
ablation_config.tie_policy: Lexicographic raw indices, missing after real indices; final state then predecessors.
ablation_config.coefficient_source: Manual illustrative unit costs, not asserted software defaults.
ablation_config.limitation: A stable wrong candidate can remain preferred; continuity does not identify resonances.

scoring.truth_source: compare.FORMANT_TRUTH evaluated at each native frame centre
scoring.eligible_rule: 0.05 <= native frame time <= maximum native frame time - 0.05 seconds
scoring.high_f0_rule: Nominal synthesis F0 at every eligible frame is at least 300 Hz
scoring.missing_policy: Nonpositive/nonfinite estimates are missing; no zero-error substitution
scoring.pooling: Individual frame errors pooled, not recording-level averages
scoring.common_support: Per labelled slot, finite positive outputs shared by native default and temporal selector
scoring.trace_selection: Fixed child_i_400 and male_a_110_natural; largest temporal labelled RMSE; largest paired RMSE increase
scoring.error_scope: Synthesis pole identity; windowing and sparse excitation can make instantaneous poles unrecoverable

diagnostic_conclusion.recommendation: Do not deploy this fixed selector: additional known-resonance regressions remain.

selection_reasons: fixed example declared before this challenge run
representative_traces.scope: Diagnostic trace selection does not change any estimator parameter.
